options.name: Now
options.line: Three big lines over the walk, and the offer says nothing between the railing and the sand.

options.name: Field Notes
options.line: Small paper tags pinned to the real beach, boat, path and rail. Each one carries a fact of the trip and rides along as the camera moves.

options.name: Bookmark
options.line: A strip of the postcard's paper down the right edge. The day prints onto it line by line as you lose height, and the price is waiting at the bottom.

options.name: Spreads
options.line: Twice on the way down the scroll holds and the page turns to paper: a magazine spread with a postcard of the view you just left.
